portal_description:
Both the ansible-rhdh-plugins and self-service-automation-portal-plugins for Red Hat Developer Hub provides an Ansible-specific portal experience for Red Hat Developer Hub. It provides step-by-step learning paths and interactive labs, push-button automation Ansible content creation, development tool integrations, and other opinionated resources curated by Red Hat Ansible.

Both the ansible-rhdh-plugins and self-service-automation-portal-plugins for Red Hat Developer Hub has been updated to 2.1.0 in this release.
